arxiv-2309-01803.title: Importance of overnight parameters to predict Sea Breeze on Long Island
arxiv-2309-01803.creator: Kira Adaricheva, Jase E. Bernhardt, Wenxin Liu, Briana Schmidt
arxiv-2309-01803.description: Abstract The sea breeze is a phenomenon frequently impacting Long Island, New York, especially during the spring and early summer, when land surface temperatures can exceed ocean temperatures considerably. The sea breeze influences daily weather conditions by causing a shift in wind direction and speed, limiting the maximum temperature, and occasionally serving as a trigger for precipitation and thunderstorms.

arxiv-2508-05453.title: Shell energies derived from three-dimensional isotropic strain-gradient elasticity
arxiv-2508-05453.creator: C. Balitactac, Y. Canzani, R. S. Hallyburton, J. Mott, C. Rodriguez
arxiv-2508-05453.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by C. Balitactac, Y. Canzani, R. S. Hallyburton, J. Mott, C. Rodriguez. We derive a class of two-dimensional shell energies for thin elastic bodies exhibiting small-length scale effects modeled via strain-gradient elasticity. Building on the final author’s earlier work on plate models, the kinetic and stored surface energies arise as the leading cubic order-in-thickness expressions for three-dimensional kinetic energies with velocity-gradient effects and a broad class of isotropic stored energies, each possessing an intrinsic length scale ℓ \ell .

pmc-10591623.creator: I Dunican, H Meaklim, M Turner, R Menzies, D Cunnington
pmc-10591623.description: IntroductionDreams that evoke intense negative emotions and anxiety, called nightmares, are often linked to mental health conditions like trauma, anxiety disorders, and death anxiety. Historically, people turned to religious and spiritual practices to address anxieties about death, but there has been a decline in such practices in recent years.

pmc-10650531.description: Neolamarckia cadamba (Roxb.) Bosser, a member of the Rubiaceae family, is a botanical species with recognized therapeutic properties. It is commonly used in traditional medicine to treat cardiac ailments and other disorders. However, the precise active constituents and the potential mechanisms by which they manage cardiovascular disorders remain unclear.

pmc-11449909.title: Stimulus duration encoding occurs early in the moth olfactory pathway

pmc-11449909.description: Pheromones convey rich ethological information and guide insects’ search behavior. The coding mechanisms that shape odor offset recognition remain elusive.

pmc-12604154.description: BackgroundTungiasis, caused by Tunga penetrans, is a neglected tropical disease of major public health concern in sub-Saharan Africa. pmc-13176951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Low‐protein foods are important clinical diet requirements for some medical diseases. The work aimed to develop low‐protein noodles (LPNs) with good structural integrity, cooking and sensory properties. Based on a three‐step noodle fabrication process, the effects of low‐protein source, designated noodle width, drying condition, cooking time, alkali and salt addition, and dough sheet thickness on the properties of LPNs were explored to obtain ideal noodles. All results suggested these factors had obvious effects on the preparation of the LPNs.
